SELECT ITEMS."NAME" AS urun, SUM(CASE WHEN STLINE."TRCODE" IN (2,3) THEN -STLINE."LINENET" ELSE STLINE."LINENET" END) AS net_satis_tutar
FROM "LG_411_01_STLINE" AS STLINE
JOIN "LG_411_ITEMS" AS ITEMS ON STLINE."STOCKREF" = ITEMS."LOGICALREF"
WHERE STLINE."CANCELLED" = 0
  AND STLINE."LINETYPE" = 0
  AND STLINE."TRCODE" IN (2, 3, 7, 8)
  AND STLINE."TRCODE" = 8
  AND STLINE."DATE_" >= '2025-04-01' AND STLINE."DATE_" < '2025-05-01'
GROUP BY ITEMS."NAME"
ORDER BY net_satis_tutar DESC
controlled_scope: Generated fixture; independent Python result oracle

SELECT ITEMS."NAME" AS urun, CLCARD."DEFINITION_" AS muster, SUM(CASE WHEN STLINE."TRCODE" IN (2,3) THEN -STLINE."LINENET" ELSE STLINE."LINENET" END) AS net_satis_tutar
FROM "LG_411_01_STLINE" AS STLINE
JOIN "LG_411_ITEMS" AS ITEMS ON STLINE."STOCKREF" = ITEMS."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_01_INVOICE" AS INVOICE ON STLINE."INVOICEREF" = INVOICE."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_CLCARD" AS CLCARD ON INVOICE."CLIENTREF" = CLCARD."LOGICALREF"
WHERE STLINE."CANCELLED" = 0
  AND STLINE."LINETYPE" = 0
  AND STLINE."TRCODE" IN (2, 3, 7, 8)
  AND STLINE."DATE_" >= '2022-04-01' AND STLINE."DATE_" < '2022-05-01'
GROUP BY ITEMS."NAME", CLCARD."DEFINITION_"
ORDER BY net_satis_tutar DESC
controlled_scope: Generated fixture; independent Python result oracle

SELECT ITEMS."NAME" AS urun, CLCARD."DEFINITION_" AS muster, SUM(STLINE."LINENET") AS satis_tutar
FROM "LG_411_01_STLINE" AS STLINE
JOIN "LG_411_ITEMS" AS ITEMS ON STLINE."STOCKREF" = ITEMS."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_01_INVOICE" AS INVOICE ON STLINE."INVOICEREF" = INVOICE."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_CLCARD" AS CLCARD ON INVOICE."CLIENTREF" = CLCARD."LOGICALREF"
WHERE STLINE."CANCELLED" = 0
  AND STLINE."LINETYPE" = 0
  AND STLINE."TRCODE" IN (7, 8)
  AND STLINE."TRCODE" = 7
  AND STLINE."DATE_" >= '2023-01-01' AND STLINE."DATE_" < '2023-02-01'
GROUP BY ITEMS."NAME", CLCARD."DEFINITION_"
ORDER BY satis_tutar DESC
controlled_scope: Generated fixture; independent Python result oracle

SELECT ITEMS."NAME" AS urun, CLCARD."DEFINITION_" AS muster, SUM(CASE WHEN STLINE."TRCODE" IN (2,3) THEN -STLINE."LINENET" ELSE STLINE."LINENET" END) AS net_satis_tutar
FROM "LG_411_01_STLINE" AS STLINE
JOIN "LG_411_ITEMS" AS ITEMS ON STLINE."STOCKREF" = ITEMS."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_01_INVOICE" AS INVOICE ON STLINE."INVOICEREF" = INVOICE."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_CLCARD" AS CLCARD ON INVOICE."CLIENTREF" = CLCARD."LOGICALREF"
WHERE STLINE."CANCELLED" = 0
  AND STLINE."LINETYPE" = 0
  AND STLINE."TRCODE" IN (2, 3, 7, 8)
  AND STLINE."TRCODE" = 7
  AND STLINE."DATE_" >= '2023-02-01' AND STLINE."DATE_" < '2023-03-01'
GROUP BY ITEMS."NAME", CLCARD."DEFINITION_"
ORDER BY net_satis_tutar DESC
controlled_scope: Generated fixture; independent Python result oracle

JOIN "LG_411_ITEMS" AS ITEMS ON STLINE."STOCKREF" = ITEMS."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_01_INVOICE" AS INVOICE ON STLINE."INVOICEREF" = INVOICE."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_CLCARD" AS CLCARD ON INVOICE."CLIENTREF" = CLCARD."LOGICALREF"

  AND STLINE."TRCODE" IN (7, 8)
  AND STLINE."TRCODE" = 8
  AND STLINE."DATE_" >= '2023-04-01' AND STLINE."DATE_" < '2023-05-01'
GROUP BY ITEMS."NAME", CLCARD."DEFINITION_"
ORDER BY satis_tutar DESC
controlled_scope: Generated fixture; independent Python result oracle

SELECT ITEMS."NAME" AS urun, CLCARD."DEFINITION_" AS muster, COUNT(STLINE."LOGICALREF") AS satis_satir_sayi
FROM "LG_411_01_STLINE" AS STLINE
JOIN "LG_411_ITEMS" AS ITEMS ON STLINE."STOCKREF" = ITEMS."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_01_INVOICE" AS INVOICE ON STLINE."INVOICEREF" = INVOICE."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_CLCARD" AS CLCARD ON INVOICE."CLIENTREF" = CLCARD."LOGICALREF"
WHERE STLINE."CANCELLED" = 0
  AND STLINE."LINETYPE" = 0
  AND STLINE."TRCODE" IN (7, 8)
  AND STLINE."DATE_" >= '2024-02-01' AND STLINE."DATE_" < '2024-03-01'
GROUP BY ITEMS."NAME", CLCARD."DEFINITION_"
ORDER BY satis_satir_sayi DESC
controlled_scope: Generated fixture; independent Python result oracle

SELECT ITEMS."NAME" AS urun, CLCARD."DEFINITION_" AS muster, SUM(CASE WHEN STLINE."TRCODE" IN (2,3) THEN -STLINE."LINENET" ELSE STLINE."LINENET" END) AS net_satis_tutar
FROM "LG_411_01_STLINE" AS STLINE
JOIN "LG_411_ITEMS" AS ITEMS ON STLINE."STOCKREF" = ITEMS."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_01_INVOICE" AS INVOICE ON STLINE."INVOICEREF" = INVOICE."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_CLCARD" AS CLCARD ON INVOICE."CLIENTREF" = CLCARD."LOGICALREF"
WHERE STLINE."CANCELLED" = 0
  AND STLINE."LINETYPE" = 0
  AND STLINE."TRCODE" IN (2, 3, 7, 8)
  AND STLINE."DATE_" >= '2024-04-01' AND STLINE."DATE_" < '2024-05-01'
GROUP BY ITEMS."NAME", CLCARD."DEFINITION_"
ORDER BY net_satis_tutar DESC
controlled_scope: Generated fixture; independent Python result oracle

SELECT ITEMS."NAME" AS urun, CLCARD."DEFINITION_" AS muster, SUM(STLINE."LINENET") AS satis_tutar
FROM "LG_411_01_STLINE" AS STLINE
JOIN "LG_411_ITEMS" AS ITEMS ON STLINE."STOCKREF" = ITEMS."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_01_INVOICE" AS INVOICE ON STLINE."INVOICEREF" = INVOICE."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_CLCARD" AS CLCARD ON INVOICE."CLIENTREF" = CLCARD."LOGICALREF"
WHERE STLINE."CANCELLED" = 0
  AND STLINE."LINETYPE" = 0
  AND STLINE."TRCODE" IN (7, 8)
  AND STLINE."TRCODE" = 7
  AND STLINE."DATE_" >= '2025-01-01' AND STLINE."DATE_" < '2025-02-01'
GROUP BY ITEMS."NAME", CLCARD."DEFINITION_"
ORDER BY satis_tutar DESC
controlled_scope: Generated fixture; independent Python result oracle

SELECT ITEMS."NAME" AS urun, CLCARD."DEFINITION_" AS muster, SUM(CASE WHEN STLINE."TRCODE" IN (2,3) THEN -STLINE."LINENET" ELSE STLINE."LINENET" END) AS net_satis_tutar
FROM "LG_411_01_STLINE" AS STLINE
JOIN "LG_411_ITEMS" AS ITEMS ON STLINE."STOCKREF" = ITEMS."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_01_INVOICE" AS INVOICE ON STLINE."INVOICEREF" = INVOICE."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_CLCARD" AS CLCARD ON INVOICE."CLIENTREF" = CLCARD."LOGICALREF"
WHERE STLINE."CANCELLED" = 0
  AND STLINE."LINETYPE" = 0
  AND STLINE."TRCODE" IN (2, 3, 7, 8)
  AND STLINE."TRCODE" = 7
  AND STLINE."DATE_" >= '2025-02-01' AND STLINE."DATE_" < '2025-03-01'
GROUP BY ITEMS."NAME", CLCARD."DEFINITION_"
ORDER BY net_satis_tutar DESC
controlled_scope: Generated fixture; independent Python result oracle

  AND STLINE."DATE_" >= '2025-04-01' AND STLINE."DATE_" < '2025-05-01'
GROUP BY ITEMS."NAME", CLCARD."DEFINITION_"
ORDER BY satis_tutar DESC

GROUP BY ITEMS."NAME", CLCARD."DEFINITION_"
ORDER BY satis_tutar DESC

SELECT ITEMS."NAME" AS urun, CLCARD."DEFINITION_" AS muster, SUM(CASE WHEN STLINE."TRCODE" IN (2,3) THEN -STLINE."LINENET" ELSE STLINE."LINENET" END) AS net_satis_tutar
FROM "LG_411_01_STLINE" AS STLINE
JOIN "LG_411_ITEMS" AS ITEMS ON STLINE."STOCKREF" = ITEMS."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_01_INVOICE" AS INVOICE ON STLINE."INVOICEREF" = INVOICE."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_CLCARD" AS CLCARD ON INVOICE."CLIENTREF" = CLCARD."LOGICALREF"
WHERE STLINE."CANCELLED" = 0
  AND STLINE."LINETYPE" = 0
  AND STLINE."TRCODE" IN (2, 3, 7, 8)
  AND STLINE."DATE_" >= '2026-09-01' AND STLINE."DATE_" < '2026-10-01'
GROUP BY ITEMS."NAME", CLCARD."DEFINITION_"
ORDER BY net_satis_tutar DESC

FROM "LG_411_01_STLINE" AS STLINE
JOIN "LG_411_ITEMS" AS ITEMS ON STLINE."STOCKREF" = ITEMS."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_01_INVOICE" AS INVOICE ON STLINE."INVOICEREF" = INVOICE."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_CLCARD" AS CLCARD ON INVOICE."CLIENTREF" = CLCARD."LOGICALREF"
WHERE STLINE."CANCELLED" = 0
  AND STLINE."LINETYPE" = 0
  AND STLINE."TRCODE" IN (7, 8)
  AND STLINE."DATE_" >= '2026-10-01' AND STLINE."DATE_" < '2026-11-01'

ORDER BY satis_satir_sayi DESC
controlled_scope: Generated fixture; independent Python result oracle

SELECT ITEMS."NAME" AS urun, CLCARD."DEFINITION_" AS muster, COUNT(STLINE."LOGICALREF") AS satis_satir_sayi
FROM "LG_411_01_STLINE" AS STLINE
JOIN "LG_411_ITEMS" AS ITEMS ON STLINE."STOCKREF" = ITEMS."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_01_INVOICE" AS INVOICE ON STLINE."INVOICEREF" = INVOICE."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_CLCARD" AS CLCARD ON INVOICE."CLIENTREF" = CLCARD."LOGICALREF"
WHERE STLINE."CANCELLED" = 0
  AND STLINE."LINETYPE" = 0
  AND STLINE."TRCODE" IN (7, 8)
  AND STLINE."TRCODE" = 7
  AND STLINE."DATE_" >= '2026-12-01' AND STLINE."DATE_" < '2027-01-01'
GROUP BY ITEMS."NAME", CLCARD."DEFINITION_"
ORDER BY satis_satir_sayi DESC
controlled_scope: Generated fixture; independent Python result oracle

SELECT SLSMAN."DEFINITION_" AS satis_temsilc, PAYPLANS."DEFINITION_" AS odem_pla, ITEMS."NAME" AS urun, CLCARD."DEFINITION_" AS muster, SUM(CASE WHEN STLINE."TRCODE" IN (2,3) THEN -STLINE."LINENET" ELSE STLINE."LINENET" END) AS net_satis_tutar
FROM "LG_411_01_STLINE" AS STLINE
JOIN "LG_411_01_INVOICE" AS INVOICE ON STLINE."INVOICEREF" = INVOICE."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_SLSMAN" AS SLSMAN ON INVOICE."SALESMANREF" = SLSMAN."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_PAYPLANS" AS PAYPLANS ON INVOICE."PAYDEFREF" = PAYPLANS."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_ITEMS" AS ITEMS ON STLINE."STOCKREF" = ITEMS."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_CLCARD" AS CLCARD ON INVOICE."CLIENTREF" = CLCARD."LOGICALREF"
WHERE STLINE."CANCELLED" = 0
  AND STLINE."LINETYPE" = 0
  AND STLINE."TRCODE" IN (2, 3, 7, 8)
  AND STLINE."DATE_" >= '2022-01-01' AND STLINE."DATE_" < '2022-02-01'
GROUP BY SLSMAN."DEFINITION_", PAYPLANS."DEFINITION_", ITEMS."NAME", CLCARD."DEFINITION_"
ORDER BY net_satis_tutar DESC
controlled_scope: Generated fixture; independent Python result oracle

SELECT SLSMAN."DEFINITION_" AS satis_temsilc, PAYPLANS."DEFINITION_" AS odem_pla, ITEMS."NAME" AS urun, CLCARD."DEFINITION_" AS muster, SUM(STLINE."LINENET") AS satis_tutar
FROM "LG_411_01_STLINE" AS STLINE
JOIN "LG_411_01_INVOICE" AS INVOICE ON STLINE."INVOICEREF" = INVOICE."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_SLSMAN" AS SLSMAN ON INVOICE."SALESMANREF" = SLSMAN."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_PAYPLANS" AS PAYPLANS ON INVOICE."PAYDEFREF" = PAYPLANS."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_ITEMS" AS ITEMS ON STLINE."STOCKREF" = ITEMS."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_CLCARD" AS CLCARD ON INVOICE."CLIENTREF" = CLCARD."LOGICALREF"
WHERE STLINE."CANCELLED" = 0
  AND STLINE."LINETYPE" = 0
  AND STLINE."TRCODE" IN (7, 8)
  AND STLINE."DATE_" >= '2022-02-01' AND STLINE."DATE_" < '2022-03-01'
GROUP BY SLSMAN."DEFINITION_", PAYPLANS."DEFINITION_", ITEMS."NAME", CLCARD."DEFINITION_"
ORDER BY satis_tutar DESC
controlled_scope: Generated fixture; independent Python result oracle

SELECT SLSMAN."DEFINITION_" AS satis_temsilc, PAYPLANS."DEFINITION_" AS odem_pla, ITEMS."NAME" AS urun, CLCARD."DEFINITION_" AS muster, SUM(CASE WHEN STLINE."TRCODE" IN (2,3) THEN -STLINE."LINENET" ELSE STLINE."LINENET" END) AS net_satis_tutar
FROM "LG_411_01_STLINE" AS STLINE
JOIN "LG_411_01_INVOICE" AS INVOICE ON STLINE."INVOICEREF" = INVOICE."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_SLSMAN" AS SLSMAN ON INVOICE."SALESMANREF" = SLSMAN."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_PAYPLANS" AS PAYPLANS ON INVOICE."PAYDEFREF" = PAYPLANS."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_ITEMS" AS ITEMS ON STLINE."STOCKREF" = ITEMS."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_CLCARD" AS CLCARD ON INVOICE."CLIENTREF" = CLCARD."LOGICALREF"
WHERE STLINE."CANCELLED" = 0
  AND STLINE."LINETYPE" = 0
  AND STLINE."TRCODE" IN (2, 3, 7, 8)
  AND STLINE."TRCODE" = 7
  AND STLINE."DATE_" >= '2022-05-01' AND STLINE."DATE_" < '2022-06-01'
GROUP BY SLSMAN."DEFINITION_", PAYPLANS."DEFINITION_", ITEMS."NAME", CLCARD."DEFINITION_"
ORDER BY net_satis_tutar DESC
controlled_scope: Generated fixture; independent Python result oracle

SELECT SLSMAN."DEFINITION_" AS satis_temsilc, PAYPLANS."DEFINITION_" AS odem_pla, ITEMS."NAME" AS urun, CLCARD."DEFINITION_" AS muster, SUM(STLINE."AMOUNT") AS satilan_adet
FROM "LG_411_01_STLINE" AS STLINE
JOIN "LG_411_01_INVOICE" AS INVOICE ON STLINE."INVOICEREF" = INVOICE."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_SLSMAN" AS SLSMAN ON INVOICE."SALESMANREF" = SLSMAN."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_PAYPLANS" AS PAYPLANS ON INVOICE."PAYDEFREF" = PAYPLANS."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_ITEMS" AS ITEMS ON STLINE."STOCKREF" = ITEMS."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_CLCARD" AS CLCARD ON INVOICE."CLIENTREF" = CLCARD."LOGICALREF"
WHERE STLINE."CANCELLED" = 0
  AND STLINE."LINETYPE" = 0
  AND STLINE."TRCODE" IN (7, 8)
  AND STLINE."DATE_" >= '2022-10-01' AND STLINE."DATE_" < '2022-11-01'
GROUP BY SLSMAN."DEFINITION_", PAYPLANS."DEFINITION_", ITEMS."NAME", CLCARD."DEFINITION_"
ORDER BY satilan_adet DESC
controlled_scope: Generated fixture; independent Python result oracle

SELECT SLSMAN."DEFINITION_" AS satis_temsilc, PAYPLANS."DEFINITION_" AS odem_pla, ITEMS."NAME" AS urun, CLCARD."DEFINITION_" AS muster, COUNT(STLINE."LOGICALREF") AS satis_satir_sayi
FROM "LG_411_01_STLINE" AS STLINE
JOIN "LG_411_01_INVOICE" AS INVOICE ON STLINE."INVOICEREF" = INVOICE."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_SLSMAN" AS SLSMAN ON INVOICE."SALESMANREF" = SLSMAN."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_PAYPLANS" AS PAYPLANS ON INVOICE."PAYDEFREF" = PAYPLANS."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_ITEMS" AS ITEMS ON STLINE."STOCKREF" = ITEMS."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_CLCARD" AS CLCARD ON INVOICE."CLIENTREF" = CLCARD."LOGICALREF"
WHERE STLINE."CANCELLED" = 0
  AND STLINE."LINETYPE" = 0
  AND STLINE."TRCODE" IN (7, 8)
  AND STLINE."TRCODE" = 8
  AND STLINE."DATE_" >= '2022-11-01' AND STLINE."DATE_" < '2022-12-01'
GROUP BY SLSMAN."DEFINITION_", PAYPLANS."DEFINITION_", ITEMS."NAME", CLCARD."DEFINITION_"
ORDER BY satis_satir_sayi DESC
controlled_scope: Generated fixture; independent Python result oracle

SELECT SLSMAN."DEFINITION_" AS satis_temsilc, PAYPLANS."DEFINITION_" AS odem_pla, ITEMS."NAME" AS urun, CLCARD."DEFINITION_" AS muster, COUNT(STLINE."LOGICALREF") AS satis_satir_sayi
FROM "LG_411_01_STLINE" AS STLINE
JOIN "LG_411_01_INVOICE" AS INVOICE ON STLINE."INVOICEREF" = INVOICE."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_SLSMAN" AS SLSMAN ON INVOICE."SALESMANREF" = SLSMAN."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_PAYPLANS" AS PAYPLANS ON INVOICE."PAYDEFREF" = PAYPLANS."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_ITEMS" AS ITEMS ON STLINE."STOCKREF" = ITEMS."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_CLCARD" AS CLCARD ON INVOICE."CLIENTREF" = CLCARD."LOGICALREF"
WHERE STLINE."CANCELLED" = 0
  AND STLINE."LINETYPE" = 0
  AND STLINE."TRCODE" IN (7, 8)
  AND STLINE."TRCODE" = 7
  AND STLINE."DATE_" >= '2023-02-01' AND STLINE."DATE_" < '2023-03-01'
GROUP BY SLSMAN."DEFINITION_", PAYPLANS."DEFINITION_", ITEMS."NAME", CLCARD."DEFINITION_"
ORDER BY satis_satir_sayi DESC
controlled_scope: Generated fixture; independent Python result oracle

SELECT SLSMAN."DEFINITION_" AS satis_temsilc, PAYPLANS."DEFINITION_" AS odem_pla, ITEMS."NAME" AS urun, CLCARD."DEFINITION_" AS muster, SUM(CASE WHEN STLINE."TRCODE" IN (2,3) THEN -STLINE."LINENET" ELSE STLINE."LINENET" END) AS net_satis_tutar
FROM "LG_411_01_STLINE" AS STLINE
JOIN "LG_411_01_INVOICE" AS INVOICE ON STLINE."INVOICEREF" = INVOICE."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_SLSMAN" AS SLSMAN ON INVOICE."SALESMANREF" = SLSMAN."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_PAYPLANS" AS PAYPLANS ON INVOICE."PAYDEFREF" = PAYPLANS."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_ITEMS" AS ITEMS ON STLINE."STOCKREF" = ITEMS."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_CLCARD" AS CLCARD ON INVOICE."CLIENTREF" = CLCARD."LOGICALREF"
WHERE STLINE."CANCELLED" = 0
  AND STLINE."LINETYPE" = 0
  AND STLINE."TRCODE" IN (2, 3, 7, 8)
  AND STLINE."TRCODE" = 8
  AND STLINE."DATE_" >= '2023-07-01' AND STLINE."DATE_" < '2023-08-01'
GROUP BY SLSMAN."DEFINITION_", PAYPLANS."DEFINITION_", ITEMS."NAME", CLCARD."DEFINITION_"
ORDER BY net_satis_tutar DESC
controlled_scope: Generated fixture; independent Python result oracle

SELECT SLSMAN."DEFINITION_" AS satis_temsilc, PAYPLANS."DEFINITION_" AS odem_pla, ITEMS."NAME" AS urun, CLCARD."DEFINITION_" AS muster, SUM(STLINE."LINENET") AS satis_tutar
FROM "LG_411_01_STLINE" AS STLINE
JOIN "LG_411_01_INVOICE" AS INVOICE ON STLINE."INVOICEREF" = INVOICE."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_SLSMAN" AS SLSMAN ON INVOICE."SALESMANREF" = SLSMAN."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_PAYPLANS" AS PAYPLANS ON INVOICE."PAYDEFREF" = PAYPLANS."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_ITEMS" AS ITEMS ON STLINE."STOCKREF" = ITEMS."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_CLCARD" AS CLCARD ON INVOICE."CLIENTREF" = CLCARD."LOGICALREF"
WHERE STLINE."CANCELLED" = 0
  AND STLINE."LINETYPE" = 0
  AND STLINE."TRCODE" IN (7, 8)
  AND STLINE."TRCODE" = 8
  AND STLINE."DATE_" >= '2023-08-01' AND STLINE."DATE_" < '2023-09-01'
GROUP BY SLSMAN."DEFINITION_", PAYPLANS."DEFINITION_", ITEMS."NAME", CLCARD."DEFINITION_"
ORDER BY satis_tutar DESC
controlled_scope: Generated fixture; independent Python result oracle

SELECT SLSMAN."DEFINITION_" AS satis_temsilc, PAYPLANS."DEFINITION_" AS odem_pla, ITEMS."NAME" AS urun, CLCARD."DEFINITION_" AS muster, SUM(CASE WHEN STLINE."TRCODE" IN (2,3) THEN -STLINE."LINENET" ELSE STLINE."LINENET" END) AS net_satis_tutar
FROM "LG_411_01_STLINE" AS STLINE
JOIN "LG_411_01_INVOICE" AS INVOICE ON STLINE."INVOICEREF" = INVOICE."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_SLSMAN" AS SLSMAN ON INVOICE."SALESMANREF" = SLSMAN."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_PAYPLANS" AS PAYPLANS ON INVOICE."PAYDEFREF" = PAYPLANS."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_ITEMS" AS ITEMS ON STLINE."STOCKREF" = ITEMS."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_CLCARD" AS CLCARD ON INVOICE."CLIENTREF" = CLCARD."LOGICALREF"
WHERE STLINE."CANCELLED" = 0
  AND STLINE."LINETYPE" = 0
  AND STLINE."TRCODE" IN (2, 3, 7, 8)
  AND STLINE."TRCODE" = 8
  AND STLINE."DATE_" >= '2023-08-01' AND STLINE."DATE_" < '2023-09-01'
GROUP BY SLSMAN."DEFINITION_", PAYPLANS."DEFINITION_", ITEMS."NAME", CLCARD."DEFINITION_"
ORDER BY net_satis_tutar DESC
controlled_scope: Generated fixture; independent Python result oracle

SELECT SLSMAN."DEFINITION_" AS satis_temsilc, PAYPLANS."DEFINITION_" AS odem_pla, ITEMS."NAME" AS urun, CLCARD."DEFINITION_" AS muster, SUM(CASE WHEN STLINE."TRCODE" IN (2,3) THEN -STLINE."LINENET" ELSE STLINE."LINENET" END) AS net_satis_tutar
FROM "LG_411_01_STLINE" AS STLINE
JOIN "LG_411_01_INVOICE" AS INVOICE ON STLINE."INVOICEREF" = INVOICE."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_SLSMAN" AS SLSMAN ON INVOICE."SALESMANREF" = SLSMAN."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_PAYPLANS" AS PAYPLANS ON INVOICE."PAYDEFREF" = PAYPLANS."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_ITEMS" AS ITEMS ON STLINE."STOCKREF" = ITEMS."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_CLCARD" AS CLCARD ON INVOICE."CLIENTREF" = CLCARD."LOGICALREF"
WHERE STLINE."CANCELLED" = 0
  AND STLINE."LINETYPE" = 0
  AND STLINE."TRCODE" IN (2, 3, 7, 8)
  AND STLINE."TRCODE" = 7
  AND STLINE."DATE_" >= '2023-12-01' AND STLINE."DATE_" < '2024-01-01'
GROUP BY SLSMAN."DEFINITION_", PAYPLANS."DEFINITION_", ITEMS."NAME", CLCARD."DEFINITION_"
ORDER BY net_satis_tutar DESC
controlled_scope: Generated fixture; independent Python result oracle

SELECT SLSMAN."DEFINITION_" AS satis_temsilc, PAYPLANS."DEFINITION_" AS odem_pla, ITEMS."NAME" AS urun, CLCARD."DEFINITION_" AS muster, COUNT(STLINE."LOGICALREF") AS satis_satir_sayi
FROM "LG_411_01_STLINE" AS STLINE
JOIN "LG_411_01_INVOICE" AS INVOICE ON STLINE."INVOICEREF" = INVOICE."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_SLSMAN" AS SLSMAN ON INVOICE."SALESMANREF" = SLSMAN."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_PAYPLANS" AS PAYPLANS ON INVOICE."PAYDEFREF" = PAYPLANS."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_ITEMS" AS ITEMS ON STLINE."STOCKREF" = ITEMS."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_CLCARD" AS CLCARD ON INVOICE."CLIENTREF" = CLCARD."LOGICALREF"
WHERE STLINE."CANCELLED" = 0
  AND STLINE."LINETYPE" = 0
  AND STLINE."TRCODE" IN (7, 8)
  AND STLINE."DATE_" >= '2024-03-01' AND STLINE."DATE_" < '2024-04-01'
GROUP BY SLSMAN."DEFINITION_", PAYPLANS."DEFINITION_", ITEMS."NAME", CLCARD."DEFINITION_"
ORDER BY satis_satir_sayi DESC
controlled_scope: Generated fixture; independent Python result oracle

SELECT SLSMAN."DEFINITION_" AS satis_temsilc, PAYPLANS."DEFINITION_" AS odem_pla, ITEMS."NAME" AS urun, CLCARD."DEFINITION_" AS muster, SUM(STLINE."AMOUNT") AS satilan_adet
FROM "LG_411_01_STLINE" AS STLINE
JOIN "LG_411_01_INVOICE" AS INVOICE ON STLINE."INVOICEREF" = INVOICE."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_SLSMAN" AS SLSMAN ON INVOICE."SALESMANREF" = SLSMAN."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_PAYPLANS" AS PAYPLANS ON INVOICE."PAYDEFREF" = PAYPLANS."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_ITEMS" AS ITEMS ON STLINE."STOCKREF" = ITEMS."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_CLCARD" AS CLCARD ON INVOICE."CLIENTREF" = CLCARD."LOGICALREF"
WHERE STLINE."CANCELLED" = 0
  AND STLINE."LINETYPE" = 0
  AND STLINE."TRCODE" IN (7, 8)
  AND STLINE."TRCODE" = 8
  AND STLINE."DATE_" >= '2024-07-01' AND STLINE."DATE_" < '2024-08-01'
GROUP BY SLSMAN."DEFINITION_", PAYPLANS."DEFINITION_", ITEMS."NAME", CLCARD."DEFINITION_"
ORDER BY satilan_adet DESC
controlled_scope: Generated fixture; independent Python result oracle

SELECT SLSMAN."DEFINITION_" AS satis_temsilc, PAYPLANS."DEFINITION_" AS odem_pla, ITEMS."NAME" AS urun, CLCARD."DEFINITION_" AS muster, SUM(STLINE."AMOUNT") AS satilan_adet
FROM "LG_411_01_STLINE" AS STLINE
JOIN "LG_411_01_INVOICE" AS INVOICE ON STLINE."INVOICEREF" = INVOICE."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_SLSMAN" AS SLSMAN ON INVOICE."SALESMANREF" = SLSMAN."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_PAYPLANS" AS PAYPLANS ON INVOICE."PAYDEFREF" = PAYPLANS."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_ITEMS" AS ITEMS ON STLINE."STOCKREF" = ITEMS."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_CLCARD" AS CLCARD ON INVOICE."CLIENTREF" = CLCARD."LOGICALREF"
WHERE STLINE."CANCELLED" = 0
  AND STLINE."LINETYPE" = 0
  AND STLINE."TRCODE" IN (7, 8)
  AND STLINE."TRCODE" = 7
  AND STLINE."DATE_" >= '2024-10-01' AND STLINE."DATE_" < '2024-11-01'
GROUP BY SLSMAN."DEFINITION_", PAYPLANS."DEFINITION_", ITEMS."NAME", CLCARD."DEFINITION_"
ORDER BY satilan_adet DESC
controlled_scope: Generated fixture; independent Python result oracle

SELECT SLSMAN."DEFINITION_" AS satis_temsilc, PAYPLANS."DEFINITION_" AS odem_pla, ITEMS."NAME" AS urun, CLCARD."DEFINITION_" AS muster, SUM(CASE WHEN STLINE."TRCODE" IN (2,3) THEN -STLINE."LINENET" ELSE STLINE."LINENET" END) AS net_satis_tutar
FROM "LG_411_01_STLINE" AS STLINE
JOIN "LG_411_01_INVOICE" AS INVOICE ON STLINE."INVOICEREF" = INVOICE."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_SLSMAN" AS SLSMAN ON INVOICE."SALESMANREF" = SLSMAN."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_PAYPLANS" AS PAYPLANS ON INVOICE."PAYDEFREF" = PAYPLANS."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_ITEMS" AS ITEMS ON STLINE."STOCKREF" = ITEMS."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_CLCARD" AS CLCARD ON INVOICE."CLIENTREF" = CLCARD."LOGICALREF"
WHERE STLINE."CANCELLED" = 0
  AND STLINE."LINETYPE" = 0
  AND STLINE."TRCODE" IN (2, 3, 7, 8)
  AND STLINE."DATE_" >= '2024-12-01' AND STLINE."DATE_" < '2025-01-01'
GROUP BY SLSMAN."DEFINITION_", PAYPLANS."DEFINITION_", ITEMS."NAME", CLCARD."DEFINITION_"
ORDER BY net_satis_tutar DESC
controlled_scope: Generated fixture; independent Python result oracle

FROM "LG_411_01_STLINE" AS STLINE
JOIN "LG_411_01_INVOICE" AS INVOICE ON STLINE."INVOICEREF" = INVOICE."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_SLSMAN" AS SLSMAN ON INVOICE."SALESMANREF" = SLSMAN."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_PAYPLANS" AS PAYPLANS ON INVOICE."PAYDEFREF" = PAYPLANS."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_ITEMS" AS ITEMS ON STLINE."STOCKREF" = ITEMS."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_CLCARD" AS CLCARD ON INVOICE."CLIENTREF" = CLCARD."LOGICALREF"
WHERE STLINE."CANCELLED" = 0
  AND STLINE."LINETYPE" = 0
  AND STLINE."TRCODE" IN (7, 8)
  AND STLINE."TRCODE" = 7
  AND STLINE."DATE_" >= '2026-01-01' AND STLINE."DATE_" < '2026-02-01'
GROUP BY SLSMAN."DEFINITION_", PAYPLANS."DEFINITION_", ITEMS."NAME", CLCARD."DEFINITION_"
ORDER BY satilan_adet DESC
controlled_scope: Generated fixture; independent Python result oracle

SELECT SLSMAN."DEFINITION_" AS satis_temsilc, PAYPLANS."DEFINITION_" AS odem_pla, ITEMS."NAME" AS urun, CLCARD."DEFINITION_" AS muster, SUM(STLINE."LINENET") AS satis_tutar
FROM "LG_411_01_STLINE" AS STLINE
JOIN "LG_411_01_INVOICE" AS INVOICE ON STLINE."INVOICEREF" = INVOICE."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_SLSMAN" AS SLSMAN ON INVOICE."SALESMANREF" = SLSMAN."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_PAYPLANS" AS PAYPLANS ON INVOICE."PAYDEFREF" = PAYPLANS."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_ITEMS" AS ITEMS ON STLINE."STOCKREF" = ITEMS."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_CLCARD" AS CLCARD ON INVOICE."CLIENTREF" = CLCARD."LOGICALREF"
WHERE STLINE."CANCELLED" = 0
  AND STLINE."LINETYPE" = 0
  AND STLINE."TRCODE" IN (7, 8)
  AND STLINE."DATE_" >= '2026-04-01' AND STLINE."DATE_" < '2026-05-01'
GROUP BY SLSMAN."DEFINITION_", PAYPLANS."DEFINITION_", ITEMS."NAME", CLCARD."DEFINITION_"
ORDER BY satis_tutar DESC
controlled_scope: Generated fixture; independent Python result oracle

SELECT SHIPINFO."CITY" AS teslimat_sehr, SLSMAN."DEFINITION_" AS satis_temsilc, PAYPLANS."DEFINITION_" AS odem_pla, ITEMS."NAME" AS urun, CLCARD."DEFINITION_" AS muster, SUM(CASE WHEN STLINE."TRCODE" IN (2,3) THEN -STLINE."LINENET" ELSE STLINE."LINENET" END) AS net_satis_tutar
FROM "LG_411_01_STLINE" AS STLINE
JOIN "LG_411_01_INVOICE" AS INVOICE ON STLINE."INVOICEREF" = INVOICE."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_SHIPINFO" AS SHIPINFO ON INVOICE."SHIPINFOREF" = SHIPINFO."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_SLSMAN" AS SLSMAN ON INVOICE."SALESMANREF" = SLSMAN."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_PAYPLANS" AS PAYPLANS ON INVOICE."PAYDEFREF" = PAYPLANS."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_ITEMS" AS ITEMS ON STLINE."STOCKREF" = ITEMS."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_CLCARD" AS CLCARD ON INVOICE."CLIENTREF" = CLCARD."LOGICALREF"
WHERE STLINE."CANCELLED" = 0
  AND STLINE."LINETYPE" = 0
  AND STLINE."TRCODE" IN (2, 3, 7, 8)
  AND STLINE."TRCODE" = 8
  AND STLINE."DATE_" >= '2022-01-01' AND STLINE."DATE_" < '2022-02-01'
GROUP BY SHIPINFO."CITY", SLSMAN."DEFINITION_", PAYPLANS."DEFINITION_", ITEMS."NAME", CLCARD."DEFINITION_"
ORDER BY net_satis_tutar DESC
controlled_scope: Generated fixture; independent Python result oracle

SELECT SHIPINFO."CITY" AS teslimat_sehr, SLSMAN."DEFINITION_" AS satis_temsilc, PAYPLANS."DEFINITION_" AS odem_pla, ITEMS."NAME" AS urun, CLCARD."DEFINITION_" AS muster, SUM(STLINE."LINENET") AS satis_tutar
FROM "LG_411_01_STLINE" AS STLINE
JOIN "LG_411_01_INVOICE" AS INVOICE ON STLINE."INVOICEREF" = INVOICE."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_SHIPINFO" AS SHIPINFO ON INVOICE."SHIPINFOREF" = SHIPINFO."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_SLSMAN" AS SLSMAN ON INVOICE."SALESMANREF" = SLSMAN."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_PAYPLANS" AS PAYPLANS ON INVOICE."PAYDEFREF" = PAYPLANS."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_ITEMS" AS ITEMS ON STLINE."STOCKREF" = ITEMS."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_CLCARD" AS CLCARD ON INVOICE."CLIENTREF" = CLCARD."LOGICALREF"
WHERE STLINE."CANCELLED" = 0
  AND STLINE."LINETYPE" = 0
  AND STLINE."TRCODE" IN (7, 8)
  AND STLINE."DATE_" >= '2022-02-01' AND STLINE."DATE_" < '2022-03-01'
GROUP BY SHIPINFO."CITY", SLSMAN."DEFINITION_", PAYPLANS."DEFINITION_", ITEMS."NAME", CLCARD."DEFINITION_"
ORDER BY satis_tutar DESC
controlled_scope: Generated fixture; independent Python result oracle

SELECT UNITSETL."NAME" AS bir, SHIPINFO."CITY" AS teslimat_sehr, SLSMAN."DEFINITION_" AS satis_temsilc, PAYPLANS."DEFINITION_" AS odem_pla, ITEMS."NAME" AS urun, CLCARD."DEFINITION_" AS muster, SUM(CASE WHEN STLINE."TRCODE" IN (2,3) THEN -STLINE."LINENET" ELSE STLINE."LINENET" END) AS net_satis_tutar
FROM "LG_411_01_STLINE" AS STLINE
JOIN "LG_411_UNITSETL" AS UNITSETL ON STLINE."UOMREF" = UNITSETL."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_01_INVOICE" AS INVOICE ON STLINE."INVOICEREF" = INVOICE."LOGICALREF"

JOIN "LG_411_PAYPLANS" AS PAYPLANS ON INVOICE."PAYDEFREF" = PAYPLANS."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_ITEMS" AS ITEMS ON STLINE."STOCKREF" = ITEMS."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_CLCARD" AS CLCARD ON INVOICE."CLIENTREF" = CLCARD."LOGICALREF"
WHERE STLINE."CANCELLED" = 0
  AND STLINE."LINETYPE" = 0
  AND STLINE."TRCODE" IN (2, 3, 7, 8)
  AND STLINE."DATE_" >= '2022-10-01' AND STLINE."DATE_" < '2022-11-01'

SELECT UNITSETL."NAME" AS bir, SHIPINFO."CITY" AS teslimat_sehr, SLSMAN."DEFINITION_" AS satis_temsilc, PAYPLANS."DEFINITION_" AS odem_pla, ITEMS."NAME" AS urun, CLCARD."DEFINITION_" AS muster, SUM(STLINE."AMOUNT") AS satilan_adet
FROM "LG_411_01_STLINE" AS STLINE
JOIN "LG_411_UNITSETL" AS UNITSETL ON STLINE."UOMREF" = UNITSETL."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_01_INVOICE" AS INVOICE ON STLINE."INVOICEREF" = INVOICE."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_SHIPINFO" AS SHIPINFO ON INVOICE."SHIPINFOREF" = SHIPINFO."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_SLSMAN" AS SLSMAN ON INVOICE."SALESMANREF" = SLSMAN."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_PAYPLANS" AS PAYPLANS ON INVOICE."PAYDEFREF" = PAYPLANS."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_ITEMS" AS ITEMS ON STLINE."STOCKREF" = ITEMS."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_CLCARD" AS CLCARD ON INVOICE."CLIENTREF" = CLCARD."LOGICALREF"
WHERE STLINE."CANCELLED" = 0
  AND STLINE."LINETYPE" = 0
  AND STLINE."TRCODE" IN (7, 8)
  AND STLINE."DATE_" >= '2022-12-01' AND STLINE."DATE_" < '2023-01-01'
GROUP BY UNITSETL."NAME", SHIPINFO."CITY", SLSMAN."DEFINITION_", PAYPLANS."DEFINITION_", ITEMS."NAME", CLCARD."DEFINITION_"
ORDER BY satilan_adet DESC
controlled_scope: Generated fixture; independent Python result oracle

SELECT UNITSETL."NAME" AS bir, SHIPINFO."CITY" AS teslimat_sehr, SLSMAN."DEFINITION_" AS satis_temsilc, PAYPLANS."DEFINITION_" AS odem_pla, ITEMS."NAME" AS urun, CLCARD."DEFINITION_" AS muster, COUNT(STLINE."LOGICALREF") AS satis_satir_sayi
FROM "LG_411_01_STLINE" AS STLINE
JOIN "LG_411_UNITSETL" AS UNITSETL ON STLINE."UOMREF" = UNITSETL."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_01_INVOICE" AS INVOICE ON STLINE."INVOICEREF" = INVOICE."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_SHIPINFO" AS SHIPINFO ON INVOICE."SHIPINFOREF" = SHIPINFO."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_SLSMAN" AS SLSMAN ON INVOICE."SALESMANREF" = SLSMAN."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_PAYPLANS" AS PAYPLANS ON INVOICE."PAYDEFREF" = PAYPLANS."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_ITEMS" AS ITEMS ON STLINE."STOCKREF" = ITEMS."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_CLCARD" AS CLCARD ON INVOICE."CLIENTREF" = CLCARD."LOGICALREF"
WHERE STLINE."CANCELLED" = 0
  AND STLINE."LINETYPE" = 0
  AND STLINE."TRCODE" IN (7, 8)
  AND STLINE."TRCODE" = 7
  AND STLINE."DATE_" >= '2023-04-01' AND STLINE."DATE_" < '2023-05-01'
GROUP BY UNITSETL."NAME", SHIPINFO."CITY", SLSMAN."DEFINITION_", PAYPLANS."DEFINITION_", ITEMS."NAME", CLCARD."DEFINITION_"
ORDER BY satis_satir_sayi DESC
controlled_scope: Generated fixture; independent Python result oracle

SELECT UNITSETL."NAME" AS bir, SHIPINFO."CITY" AS teslimat_sehr, SLSMAN."DEFINITION_" AS satis_temsilc, PAYPLANS."DEFINITION_" AS odem_pla, ITEMS."NAME" AS urun, CLCARD."DEFINITION_" AS muster, SUM(CASE WHEN STLINE."TRCODE" IN (2,3) THEN -STLINE."LINENET" ELSE STLINE."LINENET" END) AS net_satis_tutar
FROM "LG_411_01_STLINE" AS STLINE
JOIN "LG_411_UNITSETL" AS UNITSETL ON STLINE."UOMREF" = UNITSETL."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_01_INVOICE" AS INVOICE ON STLINE."INVOICEREF" = INVOICE."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_SHIPINFO" AS SHIPINFO ON INVOICE."SHIPINFOREF" = SHIPINFO."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_SLSMAN" AS SLSMAN ON INVOICE."SALESMANREF" = SLSMAN."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_PAYPLANS" AS PAYPLANS ON INVOICE."PAYDEFREF" = PAYPLANS."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_ITEMS" AS ITEMS ON STLINE."STOCKREF" = ITEMS."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_CLCARD" AS CLCARD ON INVOICE."CLIENTREF" = CLCARD."LOGICALREF"
WHERE STLINE."CANCELLED" = 0
  AND STLINE."LINETYPE" = 0
  AND STLINE."TRCODE" IN (2, 3, 7, 8)
  AND STLINE."TRCODE" = 7
  AND STLINE."DATE_" >= '2023-05-01' AND STLINE."DATE_" < '2023-06-01'
GROUP BY UNITSETL."NAME", SHIPINFO."CITY", SLSMAN."DEFINITION_", PAYPLANS."DEFINITION_", ITEMS."NAME", CLCARD."DEFINITION_"
ORDER BY net_satis_tutar DESC

JOIN "LG_411_CLCARD" AS CLCARD ON INVOICE."CLIENTREF" = CLCARD."LOGICALREF"

  AND STLINE."LINETYPE" = 0

  AND STLINE."DATE_" >= '2023-11-01' AND STLINE."DATE_" < '2023-12-01'

JOIN "LG_411_CLCARD" AS CLCARD ON INVOICE."CLIENTREF" = CLCARD."LOGICALREF"

  AND STLINE."LINETYPE" = 0
  AND STLINE."TRCODE" IN (2, 3, 7, 8)

SELECT UNITSETL."NAME" AS bir, SHIPINFO."CITY" AS teslimat_sehr, SLSMAN."DEFINITION_" AS satis_temsilc, PAYPLANS."DEFINITION_" AS odem_pla, ITEMS."NAME" AS urun, CLCARD."DEFINITION_" AS muster, SUM(STLINE."LINENET") AS satis_tutar
FROM "LG_411_01_STLINE" AS STLINE
JOIN "LG_411_UNITSETL" AS UNITSETL ON STLINE."UOMREF" = UNITSETL."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_01_INVOICE" AS INVOICE ON STLINE."INVOICEREF" = INVOICE."LOGICALREF"

JOIN "LG_411_ITEMS" AS ITEMS ON STLINE."STOCKREF" = ITEMS."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_CLCARD" AS CLCARD ON INVOICE."CLIENTREF" = CLCARD."LOGICALREF"
WHERE STLINE."CANCELLED" = 0
  AND STLINE."LINETYPE" = 0
  AND STLINE."TRCODE" IN (7, 8)
  AND STLINE."DATE_" >= '2024-06-01' AND STLINE."DATE_" < '2024-07-01'
GROUP BY UNITSETL."NAME", SHIPINFO."CITY", SLSMAN."DEFINITION_", PAYPLANS."DEFINITION_", ITEMS."NAME", CLCARD."DEFINITION_"

SELECT SHIPINFO."CITY" AS teslimat_sehr, SLSMAN."DEFINITION_" AS satis_temsilc, PAYPLANS."DEFINITION_" AS odem_pla, ITEMS."NAME" AS urun, CLCARD."DEFINITION_" AS muster, COUNT(STLINE."LOGICALREF") AS satis_satir_sayi
FROM "LG_411_01_STLINE" AS STLINE
JOIN "LG_411_01_INVOICE" AS INVOICE ON STLINE."INVOICEREF" = INVOICE."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_SHIPINFO" AS SHIPINFO ON INVOICE."SHIPINFOREF" = SHIPINFO."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_SLSMAN" AS SLSMAN ON INVOICE."SALESMANREF" = SLSMAN."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_PAYPLANS" AS PAYPLANS ON INVOICE."PAYDEFREF" = PAYPLANS."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_ITEMS" AS ITEMS ON STLINE."STOCKREF" = ITEMS."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_CLCARD" AS CLCARD ON INVOICE."CLIENTREF" = CLCARD."LOGICALREF"
WHERE STLINE."CANCELLED" = 0
  AND STLINE."LINETYPE" = 0
  AND STLINE."TRCODE" IN (7, 8)
  AND STLINE."TRCODE" = 8
  AND STLINE."DATE_" >= '2024-09-01' AND STLINE."DATE_" < '2024-10-01'
GROUP BY SHIPINFO."CITY", SLSMAN."DEFINITION_", PAYPLANS."DEFINITION_", ITEMS."NAME", CLCARD."DEFINITION_"
ORDER BY satis_satir_sayi DESC
controlled_scope: Generated fixture; independent Python result oracle

SELECT SHIPINFO."CITY" AS teslimat_sehr, SLSMAN."DEFINITION_" AS satis_temsilc, PAYPLANS."DEFINITION_" AS odem_pla, ITEMS."NAME" AS urun, CLCARD."DEFINITION_" AS muster, SUM(CASE WHEN STLINE."TRCODE" IN (2,3) THEN -STLINE."LINENET" ELSE STLINE."LINENET" END) AS net_satis_tutar
FROM "LG_411_01_STLINE" AS STLINE
JOIN "LG_411_01_INVOICE" AS INVOICE ON STLINE."INVOICEREF" = INVOICE."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_SHIPINFO" AS SHIPINFO ON INVOICE."SHIPINFOREF" = SHIPINFO."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_SLSMAN" AS SLSMAN ON INVOICE."SALESMANREF" = SLSMAN."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_PAYPLANS" AS PAYPLANS ON INVOICE."PAYDEFREF" = PAYPLANS."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_ITEMS" AS ITEMS ON STLINE."STOCKREF" = ITEMS."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_CLCARD" AS CLCARD ON INVOICE."CLIENTREF" = CLCARD."LOGICALREF"
WHERE STLINE."CANCELLED" = 0
  AND STLINE."LINETYPE" = 0
  AND STLINE."TRCODE" IN (2, 3, 7, 8)
  AND STLINE."TRCODE" = 8
  AND STLINE."DATE_" >= '2024-10-01' AND STLINE."DATE_" < '2024-11-01'
GROUP BY SHIPINFO."CITY", SLSMAN."DEFINITION_", PAYPLANS."DEFINITION_", ITEMS."NAME", CLCARD."DEFINITION_"
ORDER BY net_satis_tutar DESC
controlled_scope: Generated fixture; independent Python result oracle

SELECT UNITSETL."NAME" AS bir, SHIPINFO."CITY" AS teslimat_sehr, SLSMAN."DEFINITION_" AS satis_temsilc, PAYPLANS."DEFINITION_" AS odem_pla, ITEMS."NAME" AS urun, CLCARD."DEFINITION_" AS muster, SUM(CASE WHEN STLINE."TRCODE" IN (2,3) THEN -STLINE."LINENET" ELSE STLINE."LINENET" END) AS net_satis_tutar

JOIN "LG_411_CLCARD" AS CLCARD ON INVOICE."CLIENTREF" = CLCARD."LOGICALREF"
WHERE STLINE."CANCELLED" = 0
  AND STLINE."LINETYPE" = 0
  AND STLINE."TRCODE" IN (2, 3, 7, 8)
  AND STLINE."TRCODE" = 8
  AND STLINE."DATE_" >= '2025-01-01' AND STLINE."DATE_" < '2025-02-01'

FROM "LG_411_01_STLINE" AS STLINE

JOIN "LG_411_01_INVOICE" AS INVOICE ON STLINE."INVOICEREF" = INVOICE."LOGICALREF"

JOIN "LG_411_ITEMS" AS ITEMS ON STLINE."STOCKREF" = ITEMS."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_CLCARD" AS CLCARD ON INVOICE."CLIENTREF" = CLCARD."LOGICALREF"
WHERE STLINE."CANCELLED" = 0
  AND STLINE."LINETYPE" = 0
  AND STLINE."TRCODE" IN (7, 8)

SELECT UNITSETL."NAME" AS bir, SHIPINFO."CITY" AS teslimat_sehr, SLSMAN."DEFINITION_" AS satis_temsilc, PAYPLANS."DEFINITION_" AS odem_pla, ITEMS."NAME" AS urun, CLCARD."DEFINITION_" AS muster, SUM(STLINE."AMOUNT") AS satilan_adet
FROM "LG_411_01_STLINE" AS STLINE
JOIN "LG_411_UNITSETL" AS UNITSETL ON STLINE."UOMREF" = UNITSETL."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_01_INVOICE" AS INVOICE ON STLINE."INVOICEREF" = INVOICE."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_SHIPINFO" AS SHIPINFO ON INVOICE."SHIPINFOREF" = SHIPINFO."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_SLSMAN" AS SLSMAN ON INVOICE."SALESMANREF" = SLSMAN."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_PAYPLANS" AS PAYPLANS ON INVOICE."PAYDEFREF" = PAYPLANS."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_ITEMS" AS ITEMS ON STLINE."STOCKREF" = ITEMS."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_CLCARD" AS CLCARD ON INVOICE."CLIENTREF" = CLCARD."LOGICALREF"
WHERE STLINE."CANCELLED" = 0
  AND STLINE."LINETYPE" = 0
  AND STLINE."TRCODE" IN (7, 8)
  AND STLINE."DATE_" >= '2025-09-01' AND STLINE."DATE_" < '2025-10-01'
GROUP BY UNITSETL."NAME", SHIPINFO."CITY", SLSMAN."DEFINITION_", PAYPLANS."DEFINITION_", ITEMS."NAME", CLCARD."DEFINITION_"
ORDER BY satilan_adet DESC
controlled_scope: Generated fixture; independent Python result oracle

SELECT SHIPINFO."CITY" AS teslimat_sehr, SLSMAN."DEFINITION_" AS satis_temsilc, PAYPLANS."DEFINITION_" AS odem_pla, ITEMS."NAME" AS urun, CLCARD."DEFINITION_" AS muster, SUM(STLINE."AMOUNT") AS satilan_adet
FROM "LG_411_01_STLINE" AS STLINE
JOIN "LG_411_01_INVOICE" AS INVOICE ON STLINE."INVOICEREF" = INVOICE."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_SHIPINFO" AS SHIPINFO ON INVOICE."SHIPINFOREF" = SHIPINFO."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_SLSMAN" AS SLSMAN ON INVOICE."SALESMANREF" = SLSMAN."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_PAYPLANS" AS PAYPLANS ON INVOICE."PAYDEFREF" = PAYPLANS."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_ITEMS" AS ITEMS ON STLINE."STOCKREF" = ITEMS."LOGICALREF"
JOIN "LG_411_CLCARD" AS CLCARD ON INVOICE."CLIENTREF" = CLCARD."LOGICALREF"
WHERE STLINE."CANCELLED" = 0
  AND STLINE."LINETYPE" = 0
  AND STLINE."TRCODE" IN (7, 8)
  AND STLINE."DATE_" >= '2026-08-01' AND STLINE."DATE_" < '2026-09-01'
GROUP BY SHIPINFO."CITY", SLSMAN."DEFINITION_", PAYPLANS."DEFINITION_", ITEMS."NAME", CLCARD."DEFINITION_"
ORDER BY satilan_adet DESC
controlled_scope: Generated fixture; independent Python result oracle
